repos.name: reimbursement-agent
repos.description: AI-powered travel reimbursement approval agent built with LangGraph, Groq (Llama 3.3), ChromaDB, and FastAPI. Evaluates employee claims against company policy using RAG + agentic tool calling.

repos.name: Job-Application-Tracker
repos.description: The Job Application Tracker is a platform designed to help job seekers organize and track their job applications. This application provides a comprehensive suite of features to manage the job search process efficiently, including logging job applications, setting reminders, storing company information, and visualizing application progress.

repos.name: Chat-App
repos.description: Designed and developed a group chat application using Node.js and Express.js,  integrating real-time messaging capabilities with Socket.IO for instant communication. Designed for scalability and maintainability, ensuring smooth operation.

repos.name: Expense-Tracker
repos.description: This is a web application for tracking personal expenses. The application allows users to log their expenses, categorize them, and visualize their spending patterns over time.
